title: Family at Desert Overlook, California Car - Vintage 1930s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A family group of four stands against a low stone wall at a scenic desert overlook, with the hood and headlamp of their vintage automobile visible in the lower foreground. The group includes a man in a white collared shirt, tie, and fedora, a woman or adolescent in a brimmed cap, a young child wearing high-waisted sailor-style buttoned shorts, and an older woman wearing round spectacles, a light dress, and a sun hat. An expansive arid valley or dry lake bed stretches out behind them under harsh midday sunlight. The reverse features faint diamond watermarks reading 'LA BREA LARJA' from a Los Angeles area photographic print finisher alongside album mounting remnants.
